items.assessment: Parallel assessment questions let current hopelessness plus activation establish direct suicide inquiry as the priority; physical stability is specified.
Rested energy and grandiosity after minimal sleep distinguish reduced sleep need from fatigued insomnia, delayed phase and worry-related loss without asserting a definitive diagnosis.
Brief limit and private redirection address current peer-boundary crossing; explanation, peer discussion and group activity change are plausible but less direct approaches.
Actual five-minute focus and loss of multistep sequencing justify simple limited activities and rest over a competitive planning task; application classification is supported.
Available client-accepted sealed portions address immediate missed intake without endorsing tampering; tasting, later family meal and inspection explanation are relevant competing strategies.
Sudden mid-sentence loss of thought is distinct from globally slowed responses; pause and readiness check avoid imposing inferred content.

Original dialogue and repeated nonreturn to the question support tangential thought form; normal pace and uninterrupted speech distinguish pressured flight and blocking, while circumstantial speech eventually answers.
